自由移动，观察每条原始鼠标报文的计数与时间特征。: Move freely and inspect the counts and timing of each raw mouse event.
速度、方向和停顿都由你决定: Choose your own speed, direction and pauses
开始后在此区域移动，随时结束查看统计: Move in this area after starting; finish whenever you like
开始后锁定第一只产生相对移动的鼠标；其他设备与绝对坐标输入不混入统计。结束、失焦: The first mouse with relative movement is selected. Other devices and absolute input are excluded. Finishing, losing focus or leaving the page restores the cursor bounds.
来源为 Windows Raw Input。每条记录保留原始 dx/dy 和接收: Source: Windows Raw Input. Each record keeps its original dx/dy and receive time, without interpolation or added zero samples. This is not a USB bus capture.
等待第一只移动的鼠标: Waiting for the first moving mouse
单报文总计数 = √(dx² + dy²)。接收率含停顿时间；间隔使用程序接收时: Counts per event = √(dx² + dy²). Receive rate includes pauses; receive intervals depend on system scheduling and do not measure the physical USB polling rate.
本次未收到相对移动报文。重新开始后，移动连接本机的鼠标。: No relative movement events were received. Start again and move a mouse connected to this computer.
原始 CSV 与统计 JSON 自动保存到 Mousebox 数据目录的 mou: Raw CSV and statistics JSON are saved in mouse-debug under the Mousebox data directory. Clearing results keeps saved files.
从一条报文看鼠标如何移动: See movement one event at a time
采集结束后可查看单报文计数分布、随时间变化的计数、接收间隔以及大位移峰值。无需连: After capture, inspect counts per event, counts over time, receive intervals and movement peaks. No Reader or mouse box connection is needed.
由你决定何时结束；最多保留200万条，达到容量时自动结束并统计。: Finish whenever you like. Up to 2,000,000 events are kept; reaching capacity ends capture and starts analysis.
移入或使用方向键查看: Hover or use arrow keys to inspect
图表保留每个时间段的最小值、最大值与平均值；空白区间不补造报文。: Each interval retains its minimum, maximum and mean. Empty intervals contain no fabricated events.
鼠标特征自动保存失败，请导出原始报文。: Automatic saving failed. Please export the raw events.
请将鼠标活动区域完整显示在前台后开始采集: Bring the full mouse activity area into the foreground before starting capture
